title: Activity
description: What the agent is doing now, with the first-wait loader.

title: Alert
description: A message about the current view, inline or across the page.

title: Attachment
description: A file in a form, prompt or message, with drop zone and image tile.

title: Avatar
description: A person, agent or source icon, alone or grouped.

title: Badge
description: A static label for a count, category or kind, shown as a tinted word.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Where the page sits.

title: Button
description: Starts an action now. States: pressed and pending, which keeps the label.

title: Card
description: A white working surface for one topic, optionally collapsible.

title: Chart
description: Line, bar, sparkline or status buckets, with frame states, legend, tooltip and data table built in.

title: Checkbox
description: One option on or off, with a mixed state.

title: Collapsible
description: Shows and hides one region, or a group of them.

title: Combobox
description: A searchable choice, single, multiple or creatable.

title: Command
description: A searchable command list, the core of the command palette.

title: Conversation
description: Keeps a streaming thread pinned to the bottom until the person scrolls.

title: Copy button
description: Copies a value and confirms in place.

title: Data grid
description: A table with spreadsheet behavior: cell focus, editing and paste.

title: Data list
description: Label and value pairs for a detail view.

title: Date picker
description: A date, range, date-time or time, with Calendar as its popup part.

title: Dialog
description: Modal work, with alert and typed-confirm variants.

title: Dropdown menu
description: Actions from a trigger or a right click.

title: Empty state
description: A region with nothing to show, that failed, or that the person cannot see.

title: Field
description: Label, control, hint and error as one unit, plus the Form part.

title: Filter bar
description: Search plus filter chips and clear-all.

title: Input
description: One line of text. Variants: text, password, secret, copy, search, number and OTP, with prefix and suffix slots.

title: Item
description: The list row: media, title, meta, status and actions.

title: JSON view
description: Foldable structured output.

title: Kbd
description: A key or a shortcut.

title: Log viewer
description: Streaming lines with levels, search and follow.

title: Message
description: One turn from the person or the agent, plus dividers.

title: Pagination
description: Moves through pages of results.

title: Panel
description: A grey widget for an overview or settings screen: header on the grey, content in a white body.

title: Popover
description: Anchored rich content, including the info toggletip and the hover preview.

title: Progress
description: Bar, ring, steps or meter.

title: Prompt input
description: The composer editor with mentions, slash commands and voice.

title: Radio group
description: One choice from a short visible list.

title: Reasoning
description: The model's thinking, open while it streams and folded when done.

title: Relative time
description: "3m ago", with the exact time on hover and focus.

title: Response
description: Markdown that renders as it streams.

title: Segmented control
description: Two to five views, single or multiple.

title: Select
description: One choice from a popup list, or the native select.

title: Sheet
description: A panel from an edge, modal or docked.

title: Skeleton
description: Holds the shape of loading content.

title: Slider
description: A value or range on a track.

title: Stat
description: A plain numeral with its label, delta and trend.

title: Status
description: Idle, queued, running, waiting, ok, warn and fail, as a mark or a word.

title: Switch
description: A setting that applies immediately.

title: Table
description: Rows and columns with sort, selection, row actions and virtualization.

title: Tabs
description: Panels of one view, with closable and reorderable document tabs.

title: Textarea
description: Several lines of text that grow.

title: Timeline
description: Shows when each step of a run started and how long it took, with the slow and failed ones marked.

title: Toast
description: Confirms an action or reports a background event, then leaves.

title: Tool call
description: One call with its name, arguments, status, duration and output.

title: Tooltip
description: Names an icon button or shows a shortcut; never holds anything essential.

title: Truncate
description: Long IDs and text cut at the middle or the end, with the full value reachable.

title: Page header
description: Title, description, stats and actions at the top of a page.

title: Color picker
description: A swatch that opens saturation, hue, hex, swatches and the eyedropper in a shadcn Popover.

title: Control row
description: A labelled panel row matching the sliders, for a swatch, toggle or select.

title: Origin wave
description: A dot grid that ripples out from its origin, iOTA's spinner.

title: Pixel title
description: The wordmark types itself out, then letters keep morphing between Geist Pixel variants.

title: Scales
description: A repeating line pattern for quiet texture behind a panel.

title: Reveal
description: Fades a block up once it scrolls into view.

title: FAQ
description: Single-open questions on shadcn Accordion, the open one on a soft panel.

title: Chip
description: An interactive token: filter toggle, removable value or menu trigger.

title: Code block
description: Highlighted code, one-line commands and inline code, with copy.

title: Text effects
description: Text that arrives or changes with motion: a cycling word, a typewriter line and a word-by-word reveal.
